lines: Harmony Methodist Church
Preserved Primary Document • harmony.htm

Walking through this cemetery you will see many of the same family names that you find at Indian Mission and, indeed, many of the same names that you will find further north in Kent County. Unfortunately, many of the grave markers are quite old and are becoming impossible to read. Some of the transcriptions made 10 years ago are now lost.
Most of these entries were made between
. A more recent visit was made to update some of the listings but
a thorough update still needs to be done.

The dates have been standardized in format. Entries in quotes are inscriptions copied from the markers. Other entries are comments. The listing is not in strict alphabetical order because I have tried to group together individuals appearing in the same plot.
